current: ADR 106/00 establishes Australian design requirements for side underrun protection on vehicles. The regulation mandates structural guards or barriers fitted to the sides of applicable vehicles to prevent smaller road users, such as pedestrians or cyclists, from passing beneath the vehicle in a collision.
